sampling_rule: preselected at spaced source times inside previously source-audited solo windows, plus four group-feature and five fast-handoff frames; snap to nearest multiple-of-four source frame; no frame added or removed after reading model outcomes
reviewer_input: original video frames only, anonymous P1-P5 visual identity, no app/MoveNet outputs
annotation_rule: record confidently visible solo main ID and approximate full-person pixel xyxy box; if group, possible joint, severe occlusion, or uncertainty, preserve review state and do not force a solo score
scoring_rule: IoU >= 0.30 matches the independently labeled main person; report detection, selected main, static score rank separately; no full-video accuracy estimate
planned_offline_conditions: only switch streak counts converted from source-fps units to analyzed-frame units
only static same-frame pose-energy coefficient set to zero
continuity_guard: report count of adjacent selected boxes with IoU < 0.1 in the original visible performance window 6.0-112.5 seconds, separately from label accuracy
